title: The Telangana State Building Permission Approval and Self Certification System (TS-bPASS) Act, 2020.
full_text: The Telangana State Building Permission Approval and Self Certification System (TS-bPASS) Act, 2020. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202012 Act Number: 12 Enactment Date: 2020-09-19 Act Year: 2020 Short Title: The Telangana State Building Permission Approval and Self Certification System (TS-bPASS) Act, 2020. Long Title: An Act to provide speedy approval of Layouts / Building Permissions in a transparent and time bound manner and strict enforcement against unauthorised developments, constructions in the State of Telangana and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
